result:
Six merged PRs since 2026-04-14 added or removed a line containing `restBaseUrl` under `src`. Each one is a squash-merged commit on the default branch, so its date is when it landed on main. I took that date from the commit metadata; I did not check the PR merge timestamps separately.

Ordered by merge date, newest first:

1. **PR #661**, merged 2026-09-30 (Dennis Kigen), "Migrate stock management to workspace v2". Added `restBaseUrl` in `src/stock-items/add-stock-item/stock-item-rules/add-stock-rules.component.tsx` (lines 17 and 164).
2. **PR #630**, merged 2026-09-21 (Dennis Kigen), "Use framework modal for stock locations". Removed the `restBaseUrl` import and its use in `src/stock-locations/stock-locations-table.component.tsx` (lines 13 and 35). The current `restBaseUrl` usage in that area is in `stock-locations-table.resource.ts`.
3. **PR #616**, merged 2026-09-02 (Mwanje Musa), "Fix stock report generation, visibility, downloads, and role-based access". Changed the import in `src/stock-reports/report-list/stock-reports.component.tsx` (line 35) by removing and re-adding `restBaseUrl`.
4. **PR #542**, merged 2026-05-17 (Lubwama Samuel), "O3-5648: Wire up stock report submission…". Added `restBaseUrl` in `src/stock-reports/generate-report/create-stock-report.workspace.tsx` (lines 189 and 224).
5. **PR #552**, merged 2026-05-13 (Dennis Kigen), "Migrate from jest to vitest". Changed the `restBaseUrl` call in `src/stock-items/add-stock-item/stock-item-details/stock-item-details.component.tsx` (now line 68).
6. **PR #541**, merged 2026-05-05 (Lubwama Samuel), "O3-5647: Fix User Role Scope Save Functionality". Changed the `restBaseUrl` line in `src/stock-user-role-scopes/stock-user-role-scopes.resource.ts` (line 57).
